scope: Risk-tiered delivery, issue-linked lifecycle and Office delivery controls (WP2 + WP3 + WP5)

environment.github: fake GitHub and local bare remote only

checks.name: Office typecheck and lint
checks.command: npm run typecheck && npm run lint

checks.name: risk-tiered policy and exact-candidate guards
checks.detail: R0 auto-merge only under enabled policy; R1 requires opt-in, matching charter grant and post-merge check; R2/R3/unknown stay manual; exact head/base/Gate/policy/checks/protection re-read before merge

checks.name: salvage policy
checks.detail: R1/R2/R3 STAGNATION_SALVAGE blocked with SALVAGE_HUMAN_REVIEW_REQUIRED even with owner confirmation; missing/mismatched evidence returns SALVAGE_EVIDENCE_REQUIRED and appears as an Office blocker; R0 remains eligible

checks.name: manual R1 post-merge check
checks.detail: every effective R1 merge runs the configured post-merge check; failure opens an incident, freezes auto-merge and leaves NEEDS_ATTENTION; Factory does not auto-revert

checks.name: base-bound attempts and concurrency
checks.detail: durable attempt is reserved atomically before credentials, push, PR or issue hooks; concurrent different-base requests yield one winner and one BASE_MISMATCH with no loser side effects; sequential base change is a typed conflict

checks.name: issue-linked lifecycle
checks.detail: issue links frozen at request creation; PR-open comment; close only after merge; partial issues remain open; idempotent claims

checks.name: Office delivery surface
checks.detail: policy editor with non-default manual bases, base selector, risk/eligibility/blockers, salvage evidence state, incident/revert status; control disabled when Core reports a salvage-evidence blocker

notTested: Real GitHub push, PR, protected merge, issue comment/close and manual revert against an authorized repository
Real Chromium acceptance at desktop, tablet and 320 px in EN and ES
Authenticated human-review record/action for R1/R2/R3 salvage (delivery fails closed)
